# Genworq

> Genworq builds agentic AI systems for small and mid-sized operations: a coordinated crew of AI agents that researches, decides and executes across a company's CRM, inbox, ERP and back office, with human approval gates and a full decision trail. Content is in English with a German toggle. Contact: hello@genworq.com.

## What Genworq does
- Replaces manual busywork with AI agents that run a process end to end (not just assist with it), inside the tools a team already uses (CRM, inbox, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Slack, Supabase, n8n, spreadsheets).
- Every solution runs on one platform: an orchestrator routes each incoming task to the right agent, checks it against the customer's approval rules, and logs every action. Irreversible or sensitive steps stop for a human.
- Typical first process goes live in two to four weeks. GDPR-compliant by design (EU data residency, consent controls, role-based access).

## Pages
- [Home](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/): overview, the range of AI agents (voice, chat, workflow, multi-agent orchestration, omnichannel), live demo, savings calculator, FAQ, contact.
- [Platform](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/platform.html): the coordination layer, six capabilities (orchestration, dialog engine, integrations, human-in-the-loop, live dashboard, GDPR), governance.
- [The Orchestrator](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/platform/orchestrator.html): how work is triggered, understood, decided, acted on and logged.
- [Solutions](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions.html): the five agentic AI solutions.
- [Business Process Automation](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions/business-process-automation.html): what business process automation is, how it differs from RPA, the five-step rollout, costs and GDPR. Orders, invoicing, onboarding and procurement run end to end by AI agents.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions/ai-voice-agents.html): calls answered, qualified and booked 24/7.
- [AI Chatbots](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions/ai-chatbots.html): website chat trained on the company's own documents that answers, qualifies and books meetings.
- [Sales Automation](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions/sales-automation.html): every lead qualified and answered within minutes, meetings booked.
- [Marketing Automation](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions/marketing-automation.html): campaigns written, sent and followed up by agents with human approval of the plan.
- [E-commerce Service Automation](https://zabiagentshub.github.io/genworq-site/solutions/ecommerce-automation.html): what e-commerce customer service automation is, which shop requests can be fully automated (order status, returns, cancellations, product advice, phone orders), how agents authenticate customers, shop-stack integrations, GDPR.

## Facts worth citing
- Genworq = agentic AI for operations; agents research, decide and execute; humans approve the steps that matter.
- Savings model used on the site: 20% of a 1,600-hour work year is repetitive; valued at €37.5/hour.
- Languages: English and German. Region focus: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, EU.
